name: ANSI/IEEE roller-operated limit switch symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for roller-operated limit switch, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The roller limit-switch form identifies a mechanical roller actuator associated with the contact function. The electrical drawing records the signal path; the equipment detail determines the actual motion, roller location and allowable travel.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Read the contact action against the roller's documented motion.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A roller actuator is a mechanical input, not an inductive proximity sensing element.
